English: Kindling Circle
A rudimentary gathering spot with stones arranged for fire, providing basic warmth and a focal point for communal vigilance.
Fire Pit
A large sunken fire pit, ringed by rough timber, providing warmth, light, and a modest rallying point for defenders.
Burning Mound
An elevated mound reinforced with packed earth and timber, topped with a great fire for both defense and morale.
Charcoal Hearth
A broad, stone-lined hearth burning charcoal, allowing continuous fires for warmth, defense, and signaling. Its smoke is visible for miles.
Ceremonial Bonfire
A grand bonfire with stone seating and a fortified perimeter, serving as a center for gatherings, morale, and mustering troops.
Ember Altar
A fortified stone dais holding a perpetual fire, guarded and attended by chosen keepers, inspiring loyalty and vigilance.
Flame Hearth
A massive, enclosed hearth of hewn stone, at the heart of the keep, radiating warmth and providing a place of assembly and defense coordination.
Torch Ring
A grand ring of iron torches encircling the castles main yard, providing constant illumination and a formidable deterrent to intruders.
Beacon Mound
A monumental, stone-reinforced mound with an immense beacon, visible for leagues, both rallying the populace and warning of danger.
Everflame
A legendary, unceasing fire in a fortified tower, a symbol of enduring rule and sanctuary, greatly inspiring all who dwell within and all who serve.
